plate_comment: Routes a received TSC1 (PGN 0) by its destination address: to processEngineTsc1Request when it is the engine's own source address or global (0xff), and to cm848_processEngineRetarderTsc1Request when it is the engine retarder's source address or global (was cm848_j1939DispatchAddressHandler) | earlier note: receives J1939 PGN 0 TSC1 via the Bank-2 receive table 0x3fd414 (cm848_dispatchJ1939ReceivedMessages) - routes to torqueControlModeHandler and cm848_processEngineRetarderTsc1Request by ECM source address - registered under key 0 by cm848_initJ1939AddressDispatcher

Looks up the tsc1_source_configuration_table entry for (data link, source address); on J1939 (data link 1) an entry with source address 0xff matches any sender. Stores the match in j1939_powertrain_control_state.tsc1_matched_source_configuration_ptr and returns 0, or returns 1 when none of the ten entries matches (the caller then rejects the request) (was cm848_governorSpeedControl)

Runs the J1939 powertrain control timers each pass: the high idle override (time limit, timeout, recovery), the progressive shift disable, out of gear, ETC1 message, ETC2 gear, torque converter lockup and out of gear data timers; the J1939 output shaft speed fault (with its power-up hold-off); the engine TSC1 request timeout and time limit (cm848_runTsc1LostManagement, the ignored request list); the engine retarder TSC1 timeout and time limit; and the J1939 / J1708 link fault counts and clears (was cm848_processGovernorModeTransition)
